en.headline: Man charged over pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym granted bail
en.dek: Fung Kwok-wang, 34, faces a voyeurism count after three devices were found in changing rooms at a 24/7 Fitness branch; the case was adjourned to 25 November.
body: A construction site foreman charged with installing pinhole cameras in the changing rooms of a Sha Tin gym was granted bail at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts on Tuesday.

Fung Kwok-wang, 34, appeared on one count of voyeurism and was not required to enter a plea. Acting Principal Magistrate Cheang Kei-hong granted HK$2,000 cash bail on condition that he remain in Hong Kong, avoid contact with prosecution witnesses and stay away from the 24/7 Fitness branch on Lek Yuen Street.
Prosecutors sought an adjournment for further inquiries, including examination of the devices and identification of alleged victims. The case will return to court on 25 November.

Police said three pinhole cameras were discovered in changing rooms at the Lek Yuen Street outlet after a report on 25 September. Memory cards recovered from the devices contained footage recorded between 23 and 25 September. Officers arrested Fung at his Sha Tin home on 27 September and also seized computers and hard drives for examination.

zh.headline: 沙田健身室針孔鏡頭案 34歲地盤管工准保釋
zh.dek: 馮國浤被控窺淫罪，沙田裁判法院批准以2,000元現金保釋，案件押後至11月25日再訊。
body: 一名被控在沙田健身中心更衣室安裝針孔攝影機的地盤管工，星期二在沙田裁判法院獲准保釋。
34歲被告馮國浤被控一項窺淫罪，暫毋須答辯。署理主任裁判官鄭紀航批准他以現金2,000元保釋，條件包括不得離開香港、不得接觸控方證人，以及不得返回瀝源街的24/7 Fitness分店。
控方申請押後案件以進行進一步調查，包括檢驗涉案裝置及追蹤可能受害人。案件押後至11月25日再訊。
警方表示，9月25日接報後在該健身中心三個更衣室內發現針孔攝影機，記憶卡錄有9月23日至25日的影片。被告於9月27日在沙田住所被捕，警方同時檢走電腦及硬碟作進一步調查。
